prompts.chart2code: Generate code that recreates the chart as best as possible.
prompts.chart2csv:
Please examine this chart image. Consider you are a data visualization expert, and extract the data into a CSV table.

Your CSV should:
- Include a header row with clear column names
- Represent all data series/categories shown in the chart
- Use numeric values that match the chart as closely as possible

Output only the CSV data, nothing else.

prompts.tables_html:
Identify and extract the table schema
 Extract the schema of all the tables in the image sorted according to the reading order.
The output must be a list of valid HTML tables
prompts.tables_otsl:
Identify and extract the table schema
 Extract the schema of all the tables in the image sorted according to the reading order.
The output must be a list of valid OTSL objects, each consists of the following fields: 
                        <fcel> - a cell with content in it
                        <ecel> - an empty cell
                        <lcel> - a cell that is merged with the cell to its left
                        <ucel> - a cell that is merged with the cell above it
                        <xcel> - a cell that is merged with both the cell above it and the cell to its left
                        <nl> - a new line
                        <ched> - a column header
                        <otsl> - the beginning of the OTSL table
                        </otsl> - the end of the OTSL table

                        An example for an output:
                        [
                        <otsl><ched>first table header1<ched>first table header2<nl><fcel>data1<fcel>data2<nl><fcel>data with horizontal span<lcel><nl><fcel>data with vertical span<ecel><nl><ucel><fcel>data3<nl></otsl>,
                        <otsl><ched>second table header1<ched>second table header2<nl><fcel>data1<fcel>data2<nl><fcel>data with horizontal span<lcel><nl><fcel>data with vertical span<ecel><nl><ucel><fcel>data3<nl></otsl>
                        ]
